high_level_description: This image depicts a minimalist bedroom with a serene and cozy atmosphere. The room features a large bed with a neutral-toned upholstered headboard. The bedding consists of white pillows and a light beige or gray duvet cover, giving the space a soft and inviting feel. The bed is slightly unmade, with the duvet casually pulled back, adding to the relaxed ambiance. On either side of the bed are two nightstands. The one on the left has a small, round object that appears to be a candle or a decorative item, and there is a mirror above it reflecting part of the room.
